constellations.summary: Gunbrella Crystallize hypercarry firing lethal Rosula Shrapnel shotgun blasts.
Each Crystal Shrapnel consumed restores 3 Energy and reduces Burst CD.
Each Crystal Shrapnel increases Gunbrella CRIT Rate by 12% (up to +36%) and calls down Cannon fire.
Consuming more than 3 Shrapnel increases Gunbrella CRIT DMG by up to +135% and refunds Shrapnel.
